title: The Author of the Greatest Letter Ever Written
description: John Piper details the personal impact of the Book of Romans in his life and describes how Paul’s apostlic ministry comes from him being bought by Christ, called by Christ, and set apart for the gospel of God.

title: God’s Good News Concerning His Son
description: The gospel is not novel or new, but rooted in God’s eternal decree to purchase a people for himself and keep them forever.

title: By His Grace, for His Name, Through the Obedience of Faith
description: Every ounce of grace that enables faith and empowers our obedience comes to us through the finished work of Jesus Christ.

title: The Called of Christ and the Loved of God, Part 1
description: Who we are as Christians is ultimately based not on us, but on the work of another — he who calls us.

title: The Called of Christ and the Loved of God
description: If you’re a Christian, you have only come to faith because God called you. And if he called you, then you can be sure that he has a very special love for you.

title: The Treasure of Faith in the Life of the Church
description: The great aim of our ministry should be the same as Paul’s: to bring about the obedience of faith for the sake of God’s glory.

title: The Gospel in the Church for the Obedience of Faith Through Spiritual Gifts
description: Grace pays the debt we owe God for stealing his glory. And now we owe the gospel to any who still need God’s grace.

title: Not Ashamed of the Gospel
description: The gospel is the greatest news in the world and the most loving truth we can share. We never have to be ashamed of its message.

title: The Gospel Is the Power of God unto Salvation
description: There’s no other message in the world like the gospel. Other religions may have converts, but there is no true salvation outside the work of Jesus Christ.

title: To the Jew First, and Also to the Greek
description: All who believe can taste the hope of the gospel. No matter how rough your background God has grace for you in the good news of Jesus.
